risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's back or side showing the model number, or a video of the console powering on and displaying the PS4 home screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic PS4 console, not a PS4 Slim, which is worth less

risks.risk: The games may not be installed or may be damaged or non-functional.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have a damaged connection.

Photo of the back or side of the console showing the model number.
Video of the console powering on and showing the PS4 home screen.
Photo or video of the installed games on the console.
